ALTER TABLE "owner_1"."content_bodies" ADD CONSTRAINT body_state CHECK(state IN ('open','ready','incomplete','aborted')), ADD CONSTRAINT body_generation CHECK(writer_generation>=1 AND writer_generation<=9007199254740991), ADD CONSTRAINT body_fenced CHECK(fenced_from IS NULL OR (fenced_from>=1 AND fenced_from=writer_generation-1)), ADD CONSTRAINT body_length CHECK(byte_length>=0 AND byte_length<=9007199254740991), ADD CONSTRAINT body_revision CHECK(maintenance_version>=1), ADD CONSTRAINT body_digest CHECK((state IN ('ready','incomplete') AND digest IS NOT NULL AND digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$') OR (state IN ('open','aborted') AND digest IS NULL))

SELECT 'causation' AS kind, event.id FROM "owner_1"."events" event LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" parent ON parent.id=event.causation_id AND parent.namespace=event.namespace WHERE event.causation_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'graph namespace', edge.id FROM "owner_1"."edges" edge LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."nodes" source ON source.namespace=edge.namespace AND source.id=edge.source_node_id LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."nodes" target ON target.namespace=edge.namespace AND target.id=edge.target_node_id WHERE source.id IS NULL OR target.id IS NULL OR source.namespace<>edge.namespace OR target.namespace<>edge.namespace UNION ALL SELECT 'delivery', delivery.id FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" delivery LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=delivery.event_id WHERE event.id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'operation event', indexed.event_id FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operation_events" indexed LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=indexed.event_id AND event.namespace=indexed.namespace WHERE event.id IS NULL OR event.position<>indexed.event_position UNION ALL SELECT 'operation root', operation.operation_id FROM "owner_1"."copilotz_operations" operation LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."events" event ON event.id=operation.root_event_id AND event.namespace=operation.namespace WHERE event.id IS NULL LIMIT 1

WITH invoked AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT namespace,event_body_id FROM "owner_1"."event_bodies" WHERE COALESCE(body->'data',body)->>'status'='invoked' ), candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT e.namespace,e.id FROM "owner_1"."events" e JOIN invoked b ON b.namespace=e.namespace AND b.event_body_id=e.payload->'dataRef'->>'eventBodyId' UNION SELECT namespace,id FROM "owner_1"."events" WHERE NULLIF(owner_ingress,'null'::jsonb) IS NOT NULL OR type IN ('copilotz.server.action.requested','copilotz.server.collection.mutation.requested') UNION SELECT e.namespace,e.id FROM "owner_1"."events" e JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT event_id FROM "owner_1"."event_deliveries" WHERE status IN ('pending','leased','retry_wait')) d ON d.event_id=e.id ) SELECT e.namespace,e.id,e.metadata,e.payload,e.owner_ingress,b.body,b.digest,b.schema_version FROM candidates c JOIN "owner_1"."events" e ON e.id=c.id AND e.namespace=c.namespace LEFT JOIN "owner_1"."event_bodies" b ON b.namespace=e.namespace AND b.event_body_id=e.payload->'dataRef'->>'eventBodyId' ORDER BY e.namespace,e.id
